name: Mahtab
author: saqib33w
description: A wallpaper clock with a stylized faux-kana weekday and a family of ported Ryoku time faces, highly inspired by the Kronos Omarchy plugin.

barWidget.description: Toggle the wallpaper Mahtab clock on or off; right-click for settings.

schema.label: Show clock
schema.description: Master visibility toggle for the wallpaper clock.

schema.label: 24-hour clock
schema.description: Show the hour in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour.

schema.label: Show seconds
schema.description: Show the seconds where the layout has room for them.

schema.label: Layout style
schema.description: Presentation style: mahtab (greeting card with a faux-kana weekday), grand (editorial serif), digital, minimal, analog, flip, rings, bighour, metal, column, outline, or banner.

schema.label: Show date
schema.description: Stack a date strip centred under the time.

schema.label: Date style
schema.description: Date strip design: inline (one caption), badge (accent chip), or stacked (torn-calendar).

schema.label: Bar padding
schema.description: Extra inset from the Omarchy bar. 0 auto-detects when the bar shares the same edge.

schema.label: Show card
schema.description: Draw a rounded card behind the clock for readability on busy wallpapers.

schema.label: Text shadow
schema.description: Draw a soft halo behind the time and date so they stay legible on busy wallpapers.

schema.label: Card color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for the card. Empty uses the theme background.

schema.label: Ink color
schema.description: Hex color (#RRGGBB) for text, rules, and the kana weekday. Empty uses the theme foreground.

schema.label: Font
schema.description: Family for the greeting and date. Empty uses the Omarchy shell font.

schema.label: Show on
schema.description: Which monitors display the clock: all, primary, focused, or external.
